About 95% of the increase was concentrated at UCI Medical Center.
UCI Medical Center showed about 236 more claims.
UCI Medical Center paid per admission increased about $20K.
Chest Pain utilization increase added about $16K.
peer_benchmarking: United Health accepts facility claims on UB-04 when criteria are met and limits coverage to listed conditions.
